name: cessoes_nota_comercial_payload
description: Constrói payload de registro de Nota Comercial a partir da view cessoes_nota_comercial_reg, publica em Kafka e persiste estrutura em Delta. Recebe params com topico_kafka e kafka_broker.

transformations.query: SELECT l.*, r.parcelas FROM registros l INNER JOIN (SELECT numero_contrato, collect_list(struct(concat(numero_contrato, '1') AS codigo_controle_parcela_contrato_if, 1 AS numero_parcela)) AS parcelas FROM registros GROUP BY numero_contrato) r ON l.numero_contrato = r.numero_contrato

transformations.name: payload_nc
transformations.expression: struct(id_vert AS id_externo, struct(struct('N' AS ncEmissionTypeCode, '55639.40-2' AS otcIssuerAccountCode, codigo_tipo_emissao AS issueTypeCode, codigo_conta_contabil_otc AS otcBookkeeperAccountCode, CAST(informacoes_adicionais.numero_da_emissao AS INT) AS issueNumber, informacoes_adicionais.numero_da_serie AS serieNumber, data_emissao_contrato AS issueDate, max_data_vencimento_parcela AS maturityDate, data_referencia AS profitabilityStartDate, CAST(informacoes_adicionais.quantidade_emitida AS INT) AS issuedQuantity, CAST(informacoes_adicionais.valor_da_unidade_de_emissao AS DOUBLE) AS unitIssueValue, CAST(CAST(informacoes_adicionais.quantidade_emitida AS DOUBLE) * CAST(informacoes_adicionais.valor_da_unidade_de_emissao AS DOUBLE) AS DOUBLE) AS issueFinancialValue, codigo_regime_tributario AS regimeTypeCode, indicador_processamento_cetip AS cetipEventAttendedIndicator, 'PRIVADAVERT' AS cvmRegistrationNumber, 1 AS cvmSequentialNumber, '2026-01-12' AS cvmRegistrationDate, indicador_resgate_antecipado_unilateral AS unilateralEarlyRedemptionIndicator, informacoes_adicionais.nome_fiador AS guarantorName, indicador_presenca_agente_fiduciario AS fiduciaryAgentIndicator, nome_sacado AS issuerName, documento_sacado AS issuerDocumentNumber, CAST(informacoes_adicionais.codigo_tipo_garantia AS INT) AS guaranteeTypeCode, struct(lpad(informacoes_adicionais.codigo_metodo_pagamento, 2, '0') AS paymentMethodCode, lpad(informacoes_adicionais.codigo_do_indexador, 4, '0') AS indexCode, CASE WHEN CAST(informacoes_adicionais.codigo_do_indexador AS INT) IN (20, 99) THEN NULL ELSE CAST(percentual_taxa_variavel AS FLOAT) END AS rateFloatingPercentage, CAST(informacoes_adicionais.taxa_contrato AS INT) AS interestRateSpread, codigo_criterio_calculo_juros AS interestCalculationCriteriaCode) AS paymentMethod) AS nc) AS data)

transformations.name: headers
transformations.expression: array(named_struct('key', 'type', 'value', CAST('REGISTRO' AS BINARY)), named_struct('key', 'kind', 'value', CAST('ENVIO' AS BINARY)))
